description.text: Four people injured in Kamchatskiy Kray. At least 1,400 homes damaged, damage to infrastructure and power outages occurred in the Petropavlovsk-Kamchatskiy area. At least 106 buildings damaged at Severo-Kuril'sk. The tsunami damaged a pier at the nuclear submarine base at Avachinskaya Guba and a port at Severo-Kuril'sk, Russia and the harbor at Crescent City, CA, United States. Maximum intensity IX. This event triggered the eruption of seven volcanoes on the Kamchatka Peninsula, including Krasheninnikov. A tsunami was generated with the largest maximum wave height listed in meters based on location: 0.19 at Captain Arturo Prat Base, Antarctica; 0.21 at Gold Coast, Australia; 0.51 at Port Alberni, Canada; 2.5 at Boyeruca, Chile; 0.2 at Jiaojiang, China; 0.2 at Tumaco, Colombia; 0.17 on Rarotonga, Cook Islands; 0.39 at Playa Flamingo, Costa Rica; 1.04 on Isla Baltra, Ecuador; 0.1 at Acajutla and La Libertad, El Salvador; 0.07 at Suva, Fiji; 1.4 on Nuku Hiva, French Polynesia; 0.5 at Sarmi, Indonesia; 1.3 at Kuji, Japan; 0.58 at Zihuatanejo, Mexico; 0.1 on Dekehtik, Fed.
